name: opencode-skein
tagline: opencode, tuned for people who run their own models.
description: A maintained fork of opencode that makes local LLM backends first-class: it finds them on your network, shows you exactly what fits in VRAM, and keeps long agent sessions running unattended.

features.title: Local provider auto-discovery
features.summary: Finds Ollama, LM Studio and llama-swap (llama-skein) backends on your LAN via mDNS + port probing and offers them straight in /connect — no manual baseURL juggling.

features.title: Context window usage in the sidebar
features.summary: Live context-window bar: tokens used vs. the model's limit, a percentage, a token breakdown, throughput (tokens/sec), and cost for cloud providers.

features.title: Live VRAM/RAM usage bars
features.summary: For local models, a stacked memory bar showing model weights vs. KV cache against free VRAM/RAM — so you can see headroom before you blow past it.

features.title: Hardware-aware context-size picker
features.summary: An interactive dialog that recommends a context size from real KV-cache rate + free VRAM, with presets flagged when they'd exceed memory, and applies it to the local model.

features.title: /loop scheduling
features.summary: Run a prompt or command on a schedule or until done — ralph-style iterate-until-complete, or interval/cron based, with list/cancel/pause/resume.

features.title: Intelligent auto-reply
features.summary: Keeps long sessions moving by auto-answering input prompts — static phrases, AI-to-AI continuation, or an external webhook/CLI hook.

features.title: Loop / repetition detection
features.summary: Detects when the agent is stuck repeating itself (string-similarity over a time window) and intervenes to break the loop.

features.title: Themed local-backend loading screens
features.summary: Bridges your active TUI theme to the local backend via an X-Loading-Theme header (e.g. pip-boy → vault-boy) for matching loading visuals.

features.title: Self-maintaining fork tooling
features.summary: A manifest-driven workflow (fork:verify, sync:check) that proves no fork feature is lost on upstream syncs, plus a fork-owned updater + release pipeline so the official updater can never overwrite the skein binary.
